name: Nuclear
hook: Desktop music player that finds free music — plugin-driven, no ads, no tracking.
bullets: Plugin system: add streaming sources, metadata, dashboards via built-in plugin store
Search and stream from YouTube, SoundCloud, Bandcamp, and more
18k+ stars, cross-platform (Windows, macOS, Linux), built with Tauri
setupSteps: Download Nuclear for your platform from nuclearplayer.com or GitHub
Install and open — no account required
Go to Settings > Plugins to browse the plugin store
Install streaming providers (YouTube, SoundCloud, Bandcamp) and metadata providers (Spotify, Last.fm)
Go to Sources view in the left sidebar to select and activate your providers
details: Nuclear is a free, open-source desktop music player that streams music from multiple online sources. Everything is plugin-driven: streaming providers (YouTube, SoundCloud, Bandcamp, Khinsider), metadata providers (Spotify, Last.fm for album art and artist bios), dashboard content, and playlist imports. The built-in plugin store makes it easy to install and manage extensions. Nuclear features multiple themes, queue management with shuffle/repeat, favorites, playlist import/export, and even an MCP server so AI agents can control playback. Built with Tauri (Rust + React) for native performance. Licensed under AGPL-3.0.
setup: Install the desktop app, no server needed
